prompt: I have a design library at design/system.lib.pen with Button and Input components. Add a sign-up form to my open .pen file using those components. Explain the tools you'd call and why.

assertions.text: Describes checking the document's imports field to see if the library is already imported before attempting to add it
Instantiates Button and Input via ref nodes — does NOT describe building them from primitives (frame + text, etc.)
Describes using snapshot_layout or batch_get to verify structure and bindings BEFORE reaching for get_screenshot
Uses at most one get_screenshot call as final sign-off, scoped to the form or card subtree (NOT the page frame or document root)
